target.name: L. donovani CRK3 Kinase
target.domain_rationale: Zero-shot unseen parasite CDK protein (0 exact matches in Davis or BindingDB_Kd); catalytic fold is homologous to training CDKs.
target.disease_burden: 50,000-90,000 visceral leishmaniasis cases/year; >95% fatal if untreated, with toxic or costly current regimens.
target.target_biology: Essential cell-cycle CDK homolog governing G2/M progression in Leishmania amastigotes.
target.reference_note: FDA protein kinase inhibitors (e.g. Lapatinib, Sunitinib) have been investigated as antileishmanial repurposing leads.
